$comment: The hand-written half of this project's manifest. Everything else -- the systems, their folders, extensions and browse mode, the firmware ABI, sizes and hashes -- is derived from the packed core by scripts/make_manifest.py. Nothing derivable belongs here.

msx.$comment: No bios[] here on purpose. All ten MSX ROMs -- MSX.rom through Nextor.rom, plus the generated msxromdb.bin -- are shipped by the distribution, not found by the user: Makefile.common's prepare_msx_bios_files copies them out of blueMSX-go's Shared Roms, and msxromdb.bin is generated from msxromdb.xml by create_compact_database_file.py. bios[] means 'the user must supply this', so declaring them here would send people hunting for files they already have. Open question for the 2.0 split: with MSX leaving the firmware, this core has to ship them itself.
